name: Component Order
description: Order of components in a coupling recipe: order 0 (external interface), positive order via SCR connections, and null order.

elements.text: Component i is of order 0 when it has an unconnected input or output port.
Component i is of order m + 1 when coupled to some component of order m.
Null order: not of order m for any m (Lean `¬ ComponentHasOrder`), i.e. no chain of SCR couplings reaches a component with an external interface. Not merely “not of positive order.”

fidelity_note: Locked: null order = ¬ComponentHasOrder (no order at all), not merely “not of positive order”; required by Ex 4.66.
